dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: (This diary looks newer. Perhaps someone took it as spoils of war.)

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: "...Most of the Shogunate samurai stragglers wandering across the island have been dealt with. We need to use them to send a warning to the others..."

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: "...We should mark our borders with their personal effects. That'll show those Shogunate numbskulls that they shouldn't get too close..."
